platforms.name: WIDR 89.1 FM Music Airtime Email and External Form Route
platforms.country: United States / Kalamazoo, Michigan Western Michigan University student-radio music-airtime route
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated; physical-media production or shipping costs apply only if the sender chooses the published mailing route.
platforms.manualReviewReason: WIDR explicitly invites music-airtime requests through widr-music@wmich.edu, two external independent-artist/promoter submission links and a postal route. A human must choose the appropriate route, use the requested subject-line category, inspect the external form destination for session or CAPTCHA controls, prepare metadata and rights-cleared assets, and avoid submitting through more than one route without authorization.
platforms.notes: The official WIDR Music Submissions and home pages were verified on 2026-07-11. The station asks artists to state session, airtime or both in the email subject and publishes separate independent-artist and promoter submission links. Current activity is evidenced by 2026 summer programming, a June 20, 2026 Vine Fest review and current director recommendations. No form was opened beyond the public link, no email was sent, no files or links were supplied and no package was prepared.

platforms.name: WSUM 91.7 FM Music Director Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / Madison, Wisconsin University of Wisconsin student-radio Music Director submission route
platforms.manualReviewReason: WSUM explicitly tells artists to send music to its Music Director, but the public email is rendered as a protected/non-plaintext link and the page does not publish file-format, attachment, download-link, metadata or clean-edit requirements. A human must use the official contact link without decoding or guessing it, confirm the preferred package and complete the editorial pitch manually.
platforms.notes: The official WSUM staff and home pages were verified on 2026-07-11. The current Music Director is described as overseeing incoming music and the digital and physical library, with an explicit invitation to send music. The station published music coverage dated May 31, June 18 and June 25, 2026 and other content through July 6, 2026. The protected address was not decoded, no email was sent and no assets were transferred.

platforms.name: KGLT Alternative Public Radio Music Director Pre-Submission Inquiry Route
platforms.country: United States / Bozeman, Montana Montana State University alternative public-radio Music Director inquiry route
platforms.feeAmount: No inquiry or submission fee is stated.
platforms.manualReviewReason: KGLT publishes a current Music Director contact link and station mailing address but does not explicitly state accepted music-delivery formats, attachment or download-link rules, release windows or whether unsolicited physical media are accepted. A human must send a limited pre-submission inquiry through the official protected contact without attachments or track links and wait for authorization.
platforms.notes: The official KGLT home and About pages were verified on 2026-07-11. KGLT identifies itself as alternative public radio with about 90 live announcers, current playlists and schedules, and a 2026 fund-drive reference. The Music Director link was treated as protected/non-plaintext and was not decoded. No inquiry, file transfer or physical package was sent.

platforms.name: WMUC 90.5 FM General Pre-Submission Inquiry Route
platforms.country: United States / College Park, Maryland University of Maryland student-radio pre-submission inquiry route
platforms.feeAmount: No inquiry or submission fee is stated.
platforms.manualReviewReason: WMUC publishes wmuc@umd.edu and a station address but does not publish an explicit music-submission recipient, accepted formats, file or link rules, metadata requirements or unsolicited-media policy on the current site. A human must send only a concise pre-submission inquiry without audio attachments or track links and wait for routing instructions.
platforms.notes: The official WMUC home and schedule pages were verified on 2026-07-11. The station identifies itself as the University of Maryland's fully student-run radio station, publishes FM and digital listening routes, a schedule, archive and record-library links, plus the public station email and physical address. No email or package was sent and the general address was not treated as permission to deliver music.
